<article>
HEADLINE: Market Chatter: Exxon Mobil, QatarEnergy Joint Venture Targets LNG Exports by February

BODY:
10:06 AM EST, 11/18/2025 (MT Newswires) -- Exxon Mobil's (XOM) Golden Pass LNG joint venture with QatarEnergy is aiming for February to load its first liquefied natural gas cargo, Bloomberg reported Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

The target date could change due to the complexity of LNG production at export facilities, according to the report. Exxon said previously that Golden Pass was targeting the end of the year for its first LNG production, Bloomberg said.

QatarEnergy owns 70% of Golden Pass LNG, while Exxon Mobil owns 30%.

Exxon Mobil did not immediately respond to a request for comment from MT Newswires.

(Market Chatter news is derived from conversations with market professionals globally. This information is believed to be from reliable sources but may include rumor and speculation. Accuracy is not guaranteed.)
